flight.title: Phase 2 · Zero-G Orbital Station Operations
flight.event.solarRepaired: Solar array servos aligned above 95% output efficiency
flight.event.thermalRepaired: Ammonia cooling loop flushed and thermal core stabilized
flight.event.oxygenRepaired: CO2 scrubber cartridge replaced and O2 pressure locked in nominal band
flight.event.docking1Success: East docking seal opened: Module 3 (Power & Cooling) hard-docked
flight.event.docking2Success: North docking seal opened: Module 4 (Life Support Shaft) hard-docked
flight.event.docking3Success: South docking seal opened: Module 5 (Command Bridge) hard-docked; satellite deployed
flight.failure.lowOrbit: Insufficient delta-v to reach target orbital altitude
flight.failure.overweight: Spacecraft wet mass exceeds launcher payload limit
flight.failure.solarTimeout: Solar array servo misaligned; station energy reserves critically depleted
flight.failure.thermalTimeout: Thermal runaway in power core damaged optical instrument payload
flight.failure.oxygenTimeout: Cabin CO2 scrubber saturation and O2 drop degraded flight crew operations
flight.failure.dockingCollision: Hard docking collar impact outside 25px alignment tolerance drained station power
flight.failure.dockingTimeout: Orbital docking window missed; emergency thruster burn consumed extra propellant
flight.failure.emergencySeparation: Emergency separation triggered with unresolved orbital station crises
flight.failure.satelliteLost: Satellite lost before deployment: energy {energyPct}%, oxygen {oxygenPct}%, cabin temperature {tempC} °C.
flight.event.terminalState: Flight ended with energy {energyPct}%, oxygen {oxygenPct}% and cabin temperature {tempC} °C.
flight.lowOrbit: Insufficient delta-v: {haveMs} m/s available, {needMs} m/s required.
orbit.batteryDead: Battery depleted: {haveWh} Wh available, {needWh} Wh required in eclipse.
orbit.insufficientData: Insufficient data delivered: {deliveredMb} Mb delivered, {requiredMb} Mb required.

mission.earthObserver.title: Earth Observer
mission.earthObserver.brief: Put an imaging satellite into low Earth orbit and deliver enough data to meet the science team's requirements.
agency.borealis.name: Borealis Federation
agency.borealis.description: Large budget and the full range of launchers. Strong in software and electronics, weak in metallurgy.
agency.monsoon.name: Monsoon Union
agency.monsoon.description: Small budget, cheap launchers and strong software. No heavy launcher.
agency.kestrel.name: Kestrel Republic
agency.kestrel.description: Cheap launchers and strong heavy industry, weaker electronics and optics. Sanctions block the large camera and antenna, so they have to be developed at home.
agency.meridia.name: Meridia Concord
agency.meridia.description: Average budget, very strong optics. Careful development takes longer.
ui.lobby.title: Consortium lobby
ui.lobby.hintLocal: Everyone plays at this screen. Add players and let each pick a country; the agencies take turns designing a spacecraft for the same mission.
ui.lobby.hintOnline: Pick a country and mark yourself ready. The host starts the mission when everyone is ready.
ui.lobby.coinPending: contested: decided by a coin toss at the start
ui.lobby.coinHint: Two players want the same country: a coin toss decides it when the mission starts.
ui.menu.title: Consortium
ui.menu.localHint: Everyone takes turns on this device.
ui.menu.onlineHint: Or play online: create a room and share its code, or join a friend's room.
ui.menu.name: Your name
ui.menu.roomGone: The room is gone: the server restarted or the room expired. Create a new one.
ui.lobby.unknownAgency: The room uses a country that is not available.
ui.lobby.notReady: Waiting for everyone to be ready.
ui.actionsLeft: {n} controls left to adjust this turn (a control you already touched stays free)
ui.marginHint.dv: Speed change the engine can produce. It must be enough to reach the orbit.
ui.marginHint.energy: The battery must keep the spacecraft alive in the planet's shadow.
ui.marginHint.link: Data you can send down per orbit must cover what the camera collects.
ui.marginHint.science: Smallest visible detail. Smaller is sharper, and science needs at most the required value.
ui.marginHint.mass: The launcher must be able to lift the whole spacecraft with its propellant.
ui.marginHint.budget: Total cost of the spacecraft and the launcher must fit the budget.
ui.waitHint: Waiting makes new modules cheaper, but the deadline gets closer and data from a late launch is worth less.
ui.result.title: Mission results
ui.result.pool: Total paid out: {pool} M$ (variety bonus x{diversity})
ui.result.missed: {agency} missed the deadline and contributed nothing.
ui.dev.title: Develop your own camera
ui.dev.hint: Order a camera with exactly the aperture you need. It costs money now and takes turns, and the factory may deliver a defect that you only see after launch (an inspection lowers the risk).
ui.dev.inspect: Order an inspection (costs more and takes a turn longer)
ui.dev.ready: ready, choose it in the camera slot
design.developed: Developed a custom camera with a {apertureM} m aperture for {costMUsd} M$ over {turns} turns.
design.defect: Production defect: the camera is {blurPercent}% blurrier than designed. It was launched without an inspection, and the risk of a defect was {chancePercent}%.
design.defectInspected: Production defect: the camera is {blurPercent}% blurrier than designed, even though it was inspected. The risk of a defect was {chancePercent}%.
ui.play.flightHint: Fix the station terminals before the timers run out. Drag to sling off the handles, E opens a terminal.
ui.play.skipFlight: Finish the flight and deploy the satellite
ui.play.lostFlightHint: The satellite was lost before deployment. Continue to the failure debrief.
ui.play.orbitHint: Set the switches and fly each orbit. The spacecraft is the one you built.
ui.play.orbitNotStarted: Orbit operations never started. Review the flight causes below before trying again.
